This high-quality hand sanitiser gel is manufactured in the UK to the formula recommended by the World Health Organisation (WHO) and is practical for use in and around offices, warehouses, food production, nursing and residential care homes, catering environments and hospitals to prevent the spread of bacteria and infection.

Public Health England and the NHS advice is to ensure that hand sanitiser with a minimum of 60% alcohol content is used for the effective combatant of viruses and bacteria.
• Dispense directly to the palm and spread over hands and wrists / lower arms, ensuring that all exposed skin is covered.
• Continue to rub hands together until all sanitiser has evaporated – there is no need to dry.
• As with all alcohol-based solutions, this is highly flammable and must not be used near naked lights or sources of ignition
• Do not use on broken skin unless advised by a health professional
• Refer to the Safety Data Sheet for further advice
